supporting_observations.claim: The alerted outbound HTTPS activity is visible and repeatedly attributed to cmupdate.exe running as ben.carter on WS-BCARTER-01. Proxy records show connections to update.chartmate-imaging.net at 13:38, 13:43, 13:47, 13:52, 13:58, 14:03, and 14:08 UTC; endpoint network events link the connections to the same process.

The repeated updater activity is consistent in timing and product name with the documented ChartMate update checks, but the observed hostname is update.chartmate-imaging.net rather than the documented update.chartmate-imaging.com, and the observed executable is under the user's AppData directory rather than the documented Program Files path. The supplied evidence does not establish whether these differences are authorized.

The proxy records show mixed outcomes: several requests succeeded with status 200, while requests at 13:43 and 13:52 returned 407 and 502 respectively. A file-creation event also records cmupdate.exe creating a file at its own path during this activity; the record alone does not establish whether this was a normal self-update or tampering.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the repeated activity beginning at 13:38 UTC; they do not show the alerted activity's earlier portion from 13:30 to 13:38.
Although zeek_ssl collection is reported as available, no corresponding TLS certificate or other zeek_ssl records are included in the supplied evidence.
The provided process and network records do not include the executable's signature, hash, installation provenance, or the contents of the HTTPS exchanges.
claims_not_established: Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is an authorized ChartMate endpoint or is controlled by an unrelated party.
Whether the AppData cmupdate.exe is genuine ChartMate software and whether the file creation event reflects a legitimate updater operation.
Whether the outbound exchanges carried only update-check traffic or other content.
Whether the observed activity accounts for every connection described in the alert window.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the .net hostname and AppData executable path with ChartMate or the organization's software owner, including whether this deployment is approved.
Collect the executable's hash, digital signature, file metadata, and installation/update provenance; investigate the file-creation event.
Obtain available TLS certificate, DNS resolution, and proxy destination details for the observed connections, and compare them with known-good ChartMate update activity.
unrelated_findings: A separate review may be warranted for the SMB connection from WS-BCARTER-01 to FILE-HD-01 followed by an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon. This is outside the alerted HTTPS activity and does not determine this assessment.
